G-04 named-intent helpers and compiler-enforced raw-default ban (B7); marker-only rule superseded.

G-05/G-07 (2026-11-17, EFFECT-WALL step 2, Train B12 RED): forge-warden-core is no_std, so an effect or a HashMap in the core is refused by the compiler before clippy reads the core denylist; core-read and hash-order now expect E0433 (`std` cannot be named), the stronger guard. oversized-function and z3-clean-copy-forced-hold re-anchored to core::hint / alloc::string::String.

G-06 door-clap-attribute-effect (2026-11-17, EFFECT-WALL step 3): clap's derive is gone (the CLI builds its command line in code, under the normal lint wall), so the recipe no longer plants into a clap attribute; it plants a build-time file read, #[doc = include_str!(..)], on fn cli: it compiles, so only the Q37 attribute scan can refuse it. Also (Touchstone, 1848): the core clippy.toml's std entries are now a second layer the compiler reaches first in the no_std core; they stay as defence in depth.

G-06 cli-forbid-lowered, cli-forbid-removed (2026-11-17, EFFECT-WALL step 3): the doors are the crate forge-warden-doors and main.rs carries #![forbid(clippy::disallowed_methods, clippy::disallowed_types)]; the first plant shows the compiler refusing a local exemption (E0453), the second that deleting the forbid fails the repository invariants. 24 recipes that run door unit tests moved from -p forge-warden-cli --bin forge-warden to -p forge-warden-doors --lib (the tests moved with the doors; unchanged names and diagnostics).

G-15 fixture-seam-without-debug (2026-11-17, EFFECT-WALL step 3, Bastion B1): after the doors became a crate the fixture seams are gated cfg(any(test, all(fw_fixture_cli, debug_assertions))), so a --release build with the cfg still reads the Git allowlist from /etc; door_lints pins the spelling and this plant drops debug_assertions from the allowlist seam.

G-06 cli-clap-*, cli-process-exit, cli-forbid-lowered-* (2026-11-17, EFFECT-WALL step 3, Touchstone's attack on 87d2e073): clap's own effects (get_matches, get_matches_mut, try_get_matches, print_help, print_long_help, Error::exit, Error::print) and std::process::exit are in clippy.toml, so main.rs's forbid refuses them; print_stdout, print_stderr, dbg_macro and exit are forbidden there too, so no local expect lowers them (E0453). One plant per refused call family and per newly forbidden lint.

G-06 cli-clap-matches-from-exits, cli-process-abort, cli-clap-parser-trait (2026-11-17, EFFECT-WALL step 3, Touchstone's re-attack on ddc66b1): get_matches_from (prints and exits on a parse error), clap::Parser::parse/try_parse/parse_from/update_from (usable without the derive through a hand-written impl) and std::process::abort are in clippy.toml; the parser plant's pattern requires all four Parser refusals in one run. try_get_matches_from, try_parse_from and try_update_from stay allowed (they take their arguments and return errors).
All mutation runs require --cap-lints true and unset CARGO_TARGET_DIR.
